text:
Is Robert Downey Jr's Doctor Doom the Hero or Villain of Avengers: Doomsday?
Marvel Studios tantalized fans by debuting a trailer (https://www.ign.com/articles/disney-debuts-new-avengers-doomsday-trailer-at-cinemacon-2026) for Avengers: Doomsday (https://www.ign.com/movies/avengers-doomsday) at CinemaCon back in April, but only for those lucky enough to be in the room where it happened. Fortunately, that trailer has now finally gone wide (https://www.ign.com/articles/first-proper-avengers-doomsday-trailer-reveals-thor-steve-rogers-and-doctor-doom-himself), and that means we’ve all gotten our first real taste of Robert Downey, Jr. as Doctor Doom. Suffice it to say, this isn’t just Iron Man in a green cape. 

The new Doomsday trailer doesn’t reveal a lot about the plot of the new film. If anything, it raises a bigger question about Doom’s role in this multiversal conflict. Is he the hero or the villain here? Is he the doomsday the Avengers and X-Men are desperate to prevent, or is he our heroes’ only hope against the coming destruction? Let’s take a closer look at this new footage and explore what role Doom seems to be taking in this conflict.

Avengers: Doomsday is directed by Joe and Anthony Russo and stars Robert Downey Jr., Chris Evans, Chris Hemsworth, Pedro Pascal, Paul Rudd, Anthony Mackie, Florence Pugh, Vanessa Kirby, Ebon Moss-Bachrach, Wyatt Russell, Channing Tatum, Simu Liu, Ian McKellen, Tom Hiddleston, James Marsden, Patrick Stewart, Joseph Quinn, Sebastian Stan, David Harbour, Letitia Wright, Lewis Pullman, Kelsey Grammer, Kathryn Newton, Danny Ramirez, Winston Duke, Alan Cumming, Hannah John-Kamen, Rebecca Romijn, Mabel Cadena, and Tenoch Huerta Mejía. The film releases in theaters on December 18, 2026.

The Odyssey Sets New Record for a Christopher Nolan Film - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
Director Christopher Nolan's latest blockbuster is sailing past box office expectations with a $264 million dollar global opening weekend. This exceeds Nolan's previous record-holder, The Dark Knight Rises, which earned $249 million on opening weekend in 2012. The Odyssey cost nearly $400 million to produce and market, but it might not have to go on a odyssey of its own to recoup that money. In other news, Ryan Reynolds has ideas for Deadpool 4, and believes he's done doing solo Deadpool movies. After Deadpool & Wolverine made over $1 billion in theaters worldwide, Reynolds and Disney probably want to team him up with as many heroes as possible. And finally, we’re riding Mine Cart Madness inside Super Nintendo World with The Ride Guys at Universal Epic Universe at Universal Orlando Resort.
 
Presented by Universal Orlando Resort, and its newest theme park, Universal Epic Universe.

All Events in Roblox Animal Hospital EXPLAINED
It’s absolute chaos taking care of patients in Roblox's Animal Hospital! From battling horrific monsters like Skinwalkers to dealing with sudden room fires and death rituals, keeping your patients alive is no easy feat. This video breaks down every unpredictable crisis you'll encounter on your shift so you can keep your team and your patients safe.
 
Knowing how to complete treatments, properly use the fire extinguisher, and wield tools like tasers and guns is vital for dealing with every possible event in Animal Hospital. Whether you are racing against the clock during an unexpected Ambulance Emergency, grabbing maple syrup to thwart the Monster Under the Bed, or curing a critical patient before their timer runs out, mastering these mechanics will ensure your hospital stays safe and completely anomaly-free.
